proceedings.supporting_quote: In the proceedings instituted by the second applicant against his dismissal by the company T.I. ... a settlement had been reached in the Darmstadt Labour Court on 6 September 1994.
On 21 March 1995 the Darmstadt Labour Court, following hearings, declared the applicants’ respective actions inadmissible.
